body:
Hi @ledbetterljoshua,

You can do that by using the [`connectHits` connector](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/react/connectors/connectHits.html).

Basically you will have a function giving the hits, and you can do any rendering you want based on this. More information about the connector can be found on [our dedicated guide](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/react/guide/Connectors.html).

Also, if you hit some limitations with only using `connectHits` you can use the `createConnector` function. More information on [our dedicated guide about conditional display](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/react/guide/Conditional_display.html).
